# name: # Headset ladder (run-ladder.sh, docs/lumen/device-ladder.md): crop-C and crop-T, each at 100 / 300 / 500 Mbps.
# All rungs: NVENC P1, multipass off, split ForceTwo (set explicitly: saved sessions carry Auto), HEVC 10-bit, 90 fps.
# Frame = crop with the 2.5 deg margin, 1:1 render request 3968x3232 (render_scale 1.0877 only feeds the generated Absolute sets).
# The Scale 1.0 sets after them put the Scale variant back: the server then honours the client's 1:1 request
# (docs/lumen/crop-fov.md); an Absolute size would override it.
# Band C = a100-crop-C (centred on the axis), band T = a100-crop-T (flush with the nasal edge). eye_tangents is the box the headset
# crops to itself; run-ladder.sh does not pass it to the device (the client sends the same box with Crop FOV on).
